:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative}
#### Second derivative of the exponential log-likelihood

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle, [differentiate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-derivative) the [score](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score) from @exr-prac-exp-mle-score to compute the [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) of the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik).

:::
